propositions: Extract Jira-family-general units from adapters/jira/ into a new adapters/jira_family/ package to establish a single-seam shared layer and eliminate private cross-package imports.

Relocate identity.py, pure parts of probe.py, and specific symbols from jira_fields.py to jira_family/ while keeping location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) in place and shared by dependency inversion.

Remove all duplicate definitions of local-to-Jira status/priority maps and consolidate into one canonical dict in jira_family/, adopting the deleted->Done value to fix the latent bug where ACLI path produced invalid Jira state.
Parameterize relocated symbols (sanitizers, classifier) to inject vendor-specific dependencies rather than importing pinned modules, breaking the import cycle that would prevent the new seam.
Establish a persistent import-graph structural test enforcing that jira_family/ imports only from core, and that adapters/jira/ and sibling adapters do not import sideways or from jira_family/.

Re-point all internal importers and mock.patch targets to new jira_family/ paths with aliased imports where needed to preserve module-local underscore names and __all__ exports, keeping acli*.py changes import-lines-only.
